about: Curated reading plans for Text search (docs/LIBRARY_SEARCH.md). A plan is parts read in order; each part is one work in a collection, read a number of chapters a day (Bible books, by their chapter numbers) or spread evenly over a number of days. from, to (both kept) and until (left out) mark where a part starts and stops, by an exact reference (ref) or words in the passage (find). Plans with the Bible or the Apocrypha are not offered in Open Circle.

plans.title: Oldest texts in 30 days
plans.intro: The oldest writings we can read: Ptah-hotep's advice to his son, the Pyramid Texts, the Book of the Dead, the flood tablet of Gilgamesh, Enuma Elish, Hammurabi's laws and Egyptian tales.
